purpose: Post-review audit; historical test results were already known. This is not external preregistration or a new independent test set.
paired_tests: Two-sided exact sign flips of mean paired container differences at 70% within-recording retention; enumerate all 256 assignments for each eight-container group.
multiplicity_correction: Holm across these four exploratory comparisons

nested_loco.outer_unit: container; all recordings of that container withheld
nested_loco.inner_objective: Mean over validation containers of recording-mean squared log1p reference-error prediction error
nested_loco.training_weights: Equal total weight per recording, matching the original score
nested_loco.standardization: Refit only on each training fold
nested_loco.reporting: Average recordings within each outer container, then average containers. Fold estimates share training data: descriptive results, no independent-fold p-value.

risk_coverage.coverage: Retained fraction under weights that give each recording equal total mass; one test recording per container
risk_coverage.risk: Weighted retained absolute reference error divided by retained mass
risk_coverage.thresholds: All distinct scores; tied scores enter together
risk_coverage.curve_export: At most 201 index-spaced display points per curve; AURC uses every distinct threshold before thinning
risk_coverage.aurc: Exact right-step sum of risk times coverage increments, over (0,1]; no trapezoid convention or zero-risk origin
risk_coverage.deployable_grid: 101 thresholds from development score quantiles, fixed before applying to either test group; no test-error threshold selection

recording_indicator.value: Absolute cents difference between final model pitch and median preceding pitch in the last 0.2 seconds, excluding the final sample
recording_indicator.flag_threshold: 90th percentile of development recording indicators; no test labels used
recording_indicator.interpretation: Offline diagnostic for final-pitch instability; no calibrated reliability probability

uncertainty: Archived 2000-resample percentile bootstrap intervals retained alongside exact tests. With eight containers, intervals are unstable and sign-flip inference requires joint sign symmetry under the null.
